messages:
maya: quick Q — I need to pull the 'region-health' dashboard for APAC (to investigate model latency spikes this morning). I can't find it in Grafana from my account, getting a 403. anyone have the direct link or can grant view perms?

jonathan: hey maya — link is https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/region-health/apac-overview :point_right: you might need to be in the platform-monitoring-view group to see it. which org are you signed into (SSO org)?

maya: signed in under redwood-eng (SSO). I can see other dashboards like infra-overview but not the model panels.

alerts-bot: [ALERT] model-latency-high (apac-prod) triggered at 2024-07-14T09:12:03Z — latency p95 > 600ms. Incident: #INC-2024-193

leila: @maya I can add you. we map SSO orgs to Grafana teams — redwood-eng should map to platform-monitoring-view but looks like apac dashboards are restricted to a subset. I'll add you to the team now.

leila: done — I added maya to platform-monitoring-view and gave Viewer role on the apac folder. try the link again, let me know if you still get 403.

maya: thanks — opening now... still 403.

tom: maya — sometimes the token caches. try a hard refresh and sign out/sign in, or clear the SSO session. also check that your SAML assertion includes the groups claim.

leila: hmm ok. @jonathan can you check the Grafana folder ACL for /dashboards/apac? maybe I missed a nested team.

jonathan: checking... yep, the apac folder has an extra team restriction for "apac-owners" in addition to platform-monitoring-view. leila, I can temporarily add maya to apac-owners for 1h. want me to do that?

maya: that would be perfect for now — just need to triage the latency. :pray:

jonathan: added maya to apac-owners, expiration 1 hour. you should see charts now.

maya: confirmed — I can see the dashboard and the model_health panel. grabbing p50/p95 traces now. thanks all.

maya: quick followup: where do we keep the canonical dashboard link in docs? want to paste into the incident ticket.

leila: canonical links live in the monitoring-playbook repo under docs/runbooks/dashboards.md. example entry:
```
- APAC region health: https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/region-health/apac-overview
```
Add the ticket link there and ping me if it should be permanent access.

tom: also FYI — if you're investigating model latency specifically, check traces in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood-inference.com and logs (Loki) with this query:
```
{cluster="apac-prod", service="inference-runtime"} |= "kv-cache" | json | latency > 0.5
```
That should line up with the model_health spikes.

maya: perfect. I'll drop the dashboard link and a short runbook snippet into INC-2024-193. thanks folks :thumbsup:

jonathan: np. we'll follow up to remove the temporary apac-owners grant after you confirm triage complete.

leila: leaving a note to revisit folder permissions. maybe consolidate apac dashboards under platform-monitoring-view to avoid this friction.

alerts-bot: [INFO] user maya viewed dashboard apac-overview at 2024-07-14T09:18:30Z

maya: triage done — added summary to the ticket. you can revoke my apac-owners access now.

jonathan: revoked. all good.

leila: created follow-up: MON-256 — audit apac folder teams + update monitoring-playbook with clear access matrix.

maya: thanks again everyone.
